content.value: Test whether the lines $\textstyle { \frac { x + 1 } { - 3 } } = { \frac { y - 3 } { 2 } } = { \frac { z + 2 } { 1 } }$ and $\textstyle { \frac { x } { 1 } } = { \frac { y - 7 } { - 3 } } = { \frac { z + 7 } { 2 } }$ are coplanar or not. 12 If they are coplanar,then find the equation of the plane containing them
